title: Exploiting web cache poisoning vulnerabilities
summary_en: Web (or HTTP) caching is a highly adopted practice to effectively optimize web page loading times for clients.
excerpt: Web (or HTTP) caching is a highly adopted practice to effectively optimize web page loading times for clients. However, as with most technologies, when incorrectly implemented, it may open up a new exploitable attack surface for us to look into. In this article, we'll cover what web cache poisoning vulnerabilities are, how they arise, a few effective ways to enumerate such vulnerabilities, and eventually move on to the practical exploitation part.
